headline.en: Explore animals, colors, and stories with every step.
headline.zh: 每一步，探索动物、色彩与故事。

description.en: Animal artwork, moving color, and eight separate tiles invite kids to notice, name, match, and imagine.
description.zh: 动物图案、流动色彩与 8 片独立地垫结合在一起，邀请孩子寻找、命名、配对和想象。

alt.en: Eight Animal Discovery tiles laid separately in two rows, with animal artwork and colorful liquid.
alt.zh: 八片动物探索地垫分两排单层摆放，展示动物画面和彩色液体。

headline.en: Turn each step into a color game.
headline.zh: 双色流动，玩出不断变化的路线。

description.en: Two liquid colors shift into changing patterns when kids press or step, inviting color choices and open-ended movement play.
description.zh: 两种颜色随着按压或踩踏形成变化的液体纹理，邀请孩子选择颜色、观察变化和探索路线。

alt.en: Eight Color Duos tiles in a flat two-row grid, showing their different two-color patterns.
alt.zh: 八片缤纷双色地垫平铺成两排，展示不同的双色液体纹理。

alt.en: Eight Color Duos tiles in a flat two-row grid, showing their different two-color patterns.
alt.zh: 八片缤纷双色地垫平铺成两排，展示不同的双色液体纹理。

alt.en: A child presses a pink-purple Color Duos tile among eight separate tiles.
alt.zh: 孩子双手按压粉紫双色地垫，周围共展示八片单层地垫。

label.en: Extended heart layout — more than one set
label.zh: 扩展爱心布局示例：需要多于一套

alt.en: A parent and child explore an extended heart-shaped arrangement using more than eight tiles.
alt.zh: 家长陪孩子探索爱心形扩展布局，图中使用超过八片地垫。

alt.en: A parent and child hold a tile while rearranging a separate flat path.
alt.zh: 家长和孩子一起拿起一片地垫，重新摆放地面上的独立地垫。

headline.en: Create a calm corner in blue and green.
headline.zh: 用蓝绿配色，营造一个沉静角落。

description.en: Four blue and four green tiles without animal artwork bring a coordinated palette to a reading nook, quiet corner, or sensory space.
description.zh: 四片蓝色与四片绿色地垫没有动物印刷图案，适合阅读角、安静角或感官空间中的观察活动。

alt.en: Four blue and four green Aqua Tones tiles laid flat in two rows, without animal artwork.
alt.zh: 四片蓝色与四片绿色水漾色彩地垫分两排平铺，无动物印刷画面。

alt.en: Four blue and four green Aqua Tones tiles laid flat in two rows, without animal artwork.
alt.zh: 四片蓝色与四片绿色水漾色彩地垫分两排平铺，无动物印刷画面。

alt.en: A green Aqua Tones tile photographed at an angle.
alt.zh: 绿色水漾色彩地垫的斜视外观。

alt.en: A child touches blue and green tiles beside a reading nook.
alt.zh: 孩子在阅读角旁触摸蓝绿地垫，观察液体纹理。

alt.en: Close-up of a blue tile surface and thin edge.
alt.zh: 蓝色地垫表面与薄边实拍近景。

alt.en: The photographed grey textured reverse of an Aqua Tones tile.
alt.zh: 水漾色彩地垫灰色纹理背面实拍。
